Class LocalNodeRegistry

java.lang.Object
org.openqa.selenium.grid.distributor.local.LocalNodeRegistry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable, NodeRegistry, HasReadyState
public class LocalNodeRegistry extends Object implements NodeRegistry
Default implementation of NodeRegistry that keeps nodes in memory.
